functions.name: IsPlayable
functions.docs: Returns whether the sound base is set up in a playable manner

functions.name: HasAttenuationNode
functions.docs: Returns whether or not this sound base has an attenuation node.

functions.name: GetAttenuationSettingsToApply
functions.docs: Returns a pointer to the attenuation settings that are to be applied for this node

functions.name: GetMaxDistance
functions.docs: Returns the farthest distance at which the sound could be heard

functions.name: GetDuration
functions.docs: Returns the length of the sound

functions.name: HasDelayNode
functions.docs: Returns whether or not this sound has a delay node, which means it's possible for the sound to not generate audio for a while.

functions.name: HasConcatenatorNode
functions.docs: Returns whether or not this sound has a sequencer node, which means it's possible for the owning active sound to persist even though it's not generating audio.

functions.name: IsPlayWhenSilent
functions.docs: Returns true if any of the sounds in the sound have "play when silent" enabled.

functions.name: ShouldApplyInteriorVolumes
functions.docs: Returns whether or not any part of this sound wants interior volumes applied to it

functions.name: GetCurveData
functions.docs:
Returns curves associated with this sound if it has any. By default returns nullptr, but types
supporting curves can return a corresponding curve table.

functions.name: IsOneShot
functions.docs: Query if it's one shot. One shot is defined as a sound which is intended to have a fixed duration.

functions.name: IsProcedurallyGenerated
functions.docs: Query if it's a procedurally generated sound.

functions.name: Parse
functions.signature: Parse(Target, Audio Device, Node Wave Instance Hash, Active Sound, Parse Params, Wave Instances)
functions.docs: Parses the Sound to generate the WaveInstances to play.

functions.name: GetSoundSubmix
functions.docs: Returns the SoundSubmix used for this sound.

functions.name: GetSoundSubmixSends
functions.docs: Returns the sound submix sends for this sound.

functions.name: GetSoundSourceBusSends
functions.signature: GetSoundSourceBusSends(Target, Bus Send Type, Out Sends)
functions.docs: Returns the sound source sends for this sound.

functions.name: GetConcurrencyHandles
functions.docs: Returns an array of FSoundConcurrencySettings handles.

functions.name: GetPriority
functions.docs: Returns the priority to use when evaluating concurrency.

functions.name: GetSoundWavesWithCookedAnalysisData
functions.docs: Returns whether the sound has cooked analysis data (e.g. FFT or envelope following data) and returns sound waves which have cooked data.

functions.name: HasCookedFFTData
functions.docs: Queries if the sound has cooked FFT or envelope data.

functions.name: InitParameters
functions.signature: InitParameters(Target, Parameters To Init, In Feature Name)
functions.docs: Called from the Game Thread prior to attempting to pass parameters to the ParameterTransmitter.

functions.name: InitResources
functions.docs: Called from the Game Thread prior to attempting to initialize a sound instance.

functions.name: ImplementsParameterInterface
functions.docs: Whether or not the given sound is a generator and implements an interface with the given name.

functions.name: CreateSoundGenerator
functions.docs: Creates a sound generator instance from this sound base. Return true if this is being implemented by a subclass. Sound generators procedurally generate audio in the audio render thread.

functions.name: CreateSoundGenerator
functions.signature: CreateSoundGenerator(Target, In Params, In Default Parameters)
functions.docs: Creates a sound generator instance from this sound base. Return true if this is being implemented by a subclass. Sound generators procedurally generate audio in the audio render thread.

functions.name: CreateParameterTransmitter
functions.docs: Creates a parameter transmitter for communicating with active sound instances.

functions.name: IsParameterValid
functions.docs: Returns whether parameter is valid input for the given sound

functions.name: GetAllDefaultParameters
functions.docs: Gets all the default parameters for this Asset.

functions.name: EnableSubmixSendsOnPreview
functions.docs: Whether or not this sound allows submix sends on preview.

functions.name: IsAttenuationSettingsEditable
functions.docs: Only used as an edit condition for AttenuationSettings member, as base classes may choose to provide an attenuation override implementation
